reason: The agent booked a table for ten o'clock, but reservations are only taken on the hour between 13:00 and 21:00, so ten o'clock is outside the booking window.
name: Late-night booking time

spec.goal: Book a table for two tonight at 22:00.
spec.behavior: You are brief and polite. Give your name, party size, and requested time when asked. If they read the booking details back, confirm them. Once they say the table is booked, thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Reservations can only be made for today on the hour between 13:00 and 21:00.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they cannot book a table for 22:00 tonight because that time is not available for reservations.
